# Ludwitt

> AI-powered adaptive learning platform with two tracks: (1) Basics — adaptive K-12 + adult literacy/numeracy (Math, Reading, Logic, Latin, Greek, Writing) addressing the PIAAC crisis where 28% of US adults struggle with basic literacy, and (2) Developer Training — learn to build with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, OpenClaw) through guided projects, deployment, and open-source contributions.

## Core Pages

- [About](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/about): Mission, team, PIAAC research context
- [For Adults](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/for-adults): Adult re-education solutions
- [For Schools](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/for-schools): K-12 adaptive learning
- [For Employers](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/for-employers): Workforce literacy programs
- [For Libraries](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/for-libraries): Community education
- [Research](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/research): PIAAC data and learning science
- [Pricing](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/pricing): Free tier, premium, credits, institutional
- [How It Works](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step learning process
- [FAQ](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/faq): Common questions answered
- [Compare vs Tutoring](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/compare/vs-tutoring): Cost/feature comparison

## Basics — Adaptive Learning

- [Basics Dashboard](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/basics): Math, Reading, Logic, Latin, Greek, Writing
- [AI Assistant](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/basics/ai-assistant): 24/7 AI tutoring powered by Claude
- [Study Rooms](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/basics/study-rooms): Collaborative video learning
- [Leaderboard](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/basics/leaderboard): Gamification and progress
- [Achievements](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/basics/achievements): Badges and milestones
- [Cohorts](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/basics/cohorts): Group learning with mentors

## Developer Training (ALC)

- [Developer Training Dashboard](https://pitchrise.ludwitt.com/alc): Learn to build with AI coding tools

Three paths available:
- Cursor path: Install Cursor AI editor, build a personal website, deploy to Vercel
- Claude Code path: Install Claude Code CLI, build a tweet automation agent, deploy to Firebase
- OpenClaw path: Install OpenClaw agent platform, build website + email, deploy

Post-deploy shared steps: open-source PR to cursorboston.com, Loom showcase videos, 5-year vision, AI-generated custom projects
